_meta.note: v4 (world-map W57): renames six `structures` keys off the misleading `*CostMilli` suffix — wellCostMilli/waystationCostMilli/granaryCostMilli/soulConduitCostMilli/extractorCostMilli/hatcheryCostMilli → wellCost/waystationCost/granaryCost/soulConduitCost/extractorCost/hatcheryCost. Every one of these six is a whole loam unit (compared directly against WorldEntity.CarriedLoam / WorldSector.LoamStock, never divided by 1000), never a per-mille — the `Milli` suffix lied. No value changed; published via `publish.py loam --rename-key` (order preserved), not hand-edited. v3's own note: adds three new `structures` rows' own cost/build/yield keys — soulConduit*, extractor*, hatchery* — for the new `StructureKind.Yield` catalog rows (soul conduit, extractor, hatchery). Every other key is byte-identical to v2. All nine new values are provisional placeholders, the identical sense every other structure cost/build/yield number in this file already carries — L9's economy harness, not this migration, picks the real numbers. `hatcheryYieldMultiplierMilli` (1500) is deliberately non-identity real content, not a placeholder shape-proof: a hatchery is meant to visibly matter the moment it is built.
_meta.rebalance: Never hand-edit this file. python tools/tuning/publish.py loam <dotted.key>=<value> [...] writes loam.v{n+1}.json; the old version stays on disk for revert.
